name: GeDES FatTree48 wall-clock timing on one GB200

00.description: Time the public artifact workload with a 20-million-packet pool and verify completion of all 27,648 directed TCP flows, byte counts, and terminal queue drain.

01.name: GeDES FatTree48 full Nsight Systems profile
01.description: Profile the full pinned FT48 run through terminal drain on one GB200, with CUDA graph nodes, SMs Active, SM Issue and DRAM activity. Compare completion, bytes, FCT and queue drain with an unprofiled run of the same binary.
